A Grave Mistake#001.src: There is nothing in this graveyard.
A Grave Mistake#001.speaker: Alem

A Grave Mistake#006.src: Where di.. my arm.? I need my a... I had it somewh... upstairs?
A Grave Mistake#006.dst: 내 팔.. 어디 뒀.? 팔이 필요... 어디 뒀더... 위층인가?
A Grave Mistake#006.speaker: XXXXXXX

A Grave Mistake#008.src: You were warned not to enter this forsaken place.
A Grave Mistake#008.dst: 이 버림받은 곳에 들어오지 말라 경고했을 텐데.

A Grave Mistake#009.src: But since you made it thusfar, I suppose I shall show you the truth...
A Grave Mistake#009.dst: 허나 여기까지 왔으니, 진실을 보여 주도록 하지...

A Grave Mistake#011.src: Now leave, and forget the horrors you have witnessed here today...
A Grave Mistake#011.dst: 이제 떠나라. 오늘 여기서 본 끔찍한 일은 잊어라...
A Grave Mistake#011.speaker: Mael

A Grave Mistake#012.dst: 그들은 여기 있는 편이 더 안전하다.
A Grave Mistake#012.speaker: Mael

A Grave Mistake#014.src: I have nothing more to say. Take these.
A Grave Mistake#014.dst: 더 할 말은 없소. 이걸 받으시오.
A Grave Mistake#014.speaker: Alem

A Grave Mistake#015.src: Ooh.. oh... another victim... Welcome... there is no need for a quick introduction... ... you will have just time enough now...
A Grave Mistake#015.dst: 오오.. 오... 또 한 명의 희생자... 어서 와... 인사는 필요 없어... ... 시간은 딱 그 정도만 남았으니까...
A Grave Mistake#015.speaker: Skull

A Grave Mistake#016.src: After all... you just fell into a grave... but, let us make it a little comfortable... where shall I bite first?!
A Grave Mistake#016.dst: 어쨌든... 넌 방금 무덤에 빠졌어... 그래도 좀 편하게 해 주지... 어디부터 물어뜯을까?!
A Grave Mistake#016.speaker: Skull
